sloka: अपूरयत्तस्य मुखं शिताग्रै रामः शरैर्हेमपिनद्धपुङ्खैः।स पूर्णवक्त्रो न शशाक वक्तुं चुकूज कृच्छ्रेण मुमोह चापि ।। ६.६७.१५३ ।।
transliteration: apūrayattasya mukhaṁ śitāgrai rāmaḥ śarairhemapinaddhapuṅkhaiḥ।sa pūrṇavaktro na śaśāka vaktuṁ cukūja kṛcchreṇa mumoha cāpi ।। 6.67.153 ।।

translations.english: "O Tiger of the Ikshvaku clan! Exhibit your manliness, prowess, and valour on me. I will eat you up later."
